answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. Disability benefit record with assessment history is the check: assessments passed with one agency over years. A farm faking 192 aliases needs 192 separate assessment histories, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the mirror signal is public, the falcon check is automatic, and 192 aliases cost 192 times what one real agent costs, with the dune trail open to all.
